#### Certification

The AFA Certification sets a standard to prescribe healthy hoof care.

[Read More](https://americanfarriers.org/page/certification)

**Setting the Standard for Excellence in Hoofcare**

Representing professional farriers, veterinarians, suppliers and horse owners, the American Farrier's Association is the oldest and largest national membership organization in North America for the farrier industry and the only one with internationally
recognized standards of competency through our certification programs.

If you are currently a candidate for AFA Certification, or even thinking about beginning the process of certification testing, you should explore the opportunities for attending a Pre-Certification Clinic. These clinics are taught by AFA
Certified Journeyman Farriers who have extensive experience with what is required to pass all components of the exams. You will gain step-by-step insight into what is important to know at all levels.  [Click here](https://americanfarriers.org/page/pre-certification-clinics) to learn more.

Check if there will be a clinic near you: (new dates added regularly) [View schedule](https://americanfarriers.org/events/event_list.asp?show=&group=&end=&view=&cid=19168)
